note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The tag's rows are drawn written or blank exactly as supplied; a blank row is only described, never judged. No admissibility or chain-of-custody doctrine is drawn. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState.
